title: react: the runtime depends on the ObjectStack adapter — AdapterCtx is typed by ObjectStackAdapter and components reach the concrete adapter in 28 files; type the seam by a types-level interface
body:
Filing gate ③: a maintainer-directed task. Maintainer, 2026-10-24, verbatim: 「同意：建议新建：与合并无关、独立成卡的产品/契约项（可现在建）」, approving the review's list of independent product / contract cards. Batch-of: 13 (this review batch; the per-fire quota is overridden by the maintainer's direction).

## 维护者速读

`@object-ui/react`（运行时）在运行期依赖 `@object-ui/data-objectstack`（适配器）：`AppShellContext.tsx` 用 `ObjectStackAdapter` 定型上下文，`error-message.ts` 导入适配器包的错误判定；components 经这个上下文在 28 个文件里拿到具体适配器类型，却只用 `find` / `aggregate` / `getObjectSchema` / `addRow` 四个方法。这是源码图里唯一的层次倒置，违反 AGENTS §3（适配器隔离所有 fetch 逻辑）与诫条 objectstack-ai/objectui#1（用 DataSource 接口）。改法是按 `types` 层接口定型，让 BYO 后端在类型层就知道差什么。

## Measured (2026-10-24, HEAD 7981384; import graph from source with comments stripped)

- `packages/react/src/context/AppShellContext.tsx` imports the type `ObjectStackAdapter` from `@object-ui/data-objectstack` and declares `export const AdapterCtx = createContext` over that adapter type (or null); `packages/react/src/utils/error-message.ts` imports the value `isApiAccessDeniedError` from `@object-ui/data-objectstack`. `packages/react/package.json` therefore lists `@object-ui/data-objectstack` under `dependencies`.
- `packages/components/src` reaches the concrete type through `AdapterCtx` / `useAdapter` in 28 non-test files; members used on the adapter there: `adapter.find` 82 sites, `adapter.aggregate` 51, `adapter.getObjectSchema` 3, `adapter.addRow` 1 — a four-method surface.
- No package-level cycle exists (the graph is otherwise strictly downward: types, core, i18n, react, components, fields, layout, plugins, app-shell, console); this is the one upward runtime edge.
- Business reason: `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` and the README sell a BYO-backend host (`examples/byo-backend-console`); today `react` plus `components` cannot be installed without the ObjectStack adapter, and a non-ObjectStack `DataSource` that lacks `aggregate` fails at runtime instead of at the type level.
- Dedup over the 2,012-card dump (`AdapterCtx|useAdapter.*ObjectStackAdapter|react.*data-objectstack`): 1 hit, closed, unrelated (objectui#12076, one-authority refactor). Positive control `visibleWhen` 50 hits.

## Task

- [ ] Type `AdapterCtx` by a `@object-ui/types`-level interface — `DataSource` plus `aggregate` / `getObjectSchema` if they are not already declared there (未实测: `grep -n "aggregate\|getObjectSchema" packages/types/src/data.ts` settles it; add them by reference to the spec row if absent).
- [ ] Move `isApiAccessDeniedError` to `react` or `core` (it reads `@objectstack/spec/api`, which `react` already depends on).
- [ ] Remove `@object-ui/data-objectstack` from `react`'s `dependencies`; changeset (`dependencies` is not one of the eight contract fields, but the published `.d.ts` changes — use a normal bump).

Who acts: the objectui `domain:ui` execution seat, one os-dev PR. Effort M. Risk: type-only change; rollback is one import. Related: objectui#12076 (closed).
